parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The provider of the public command. The following list describes the valid values of this parameter:

If you do not specify this parameter, all Cloud Assistant commands that you manually created are queried by default.
If you set this parameter to `AlibabaCloud`, all public commands provided by Alibaba Cloud are queried.
If you set this parameter to a specific public command provider, all public commands provided by the provider are queried. Examples:
    - If you set `Provider=AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOS`, all public commands provided by `AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOS` are queried.
    - If you set `Provider=AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOSDiagnose`, all public commands provided by `AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOSDiagnose` are queried
parameters.help_zh:
公共命令的提供者。参数值的具体说明如下：

当该参数不传值时，默认查询您手动创建的所有云助手命令。
当该参数取值为`AlibabaCloud`时，查询由阿里云提供的所有公共命令。
当该参数的取值为具体的公共命令提供者时，查询该提供者提供的所有公共命令。例如：
    - 当`Provider=AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOS`时，查询`AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOS`提供的公共命令。
    - 当`Provider=AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOSDiagnose`时，查询`AlibabaCloud.ECS.GuestOSDiagnose`提供的公共命令
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en:
The name of the command.

If you specify the `Provider` parameter parameter query public commands, fuzzy search is supported by default.

If you do not specify the `Provider` parameter parameter query private commands, fuzzy search is supported. For example, enter `command*` to search for all commands whose names start with `command`, enter `*command` to search for all commands whose names end with `command`, or enter `*command*` to search for all commands whose names contain `command`
parameters.help_zh:
命令的名称。

当指定了`Provider`参数查询公共命令时，默认支持模糊查询。

当未指定`Provider`参数查询私有命令时，支持模糊查询，例如输入`command*`，可以搜索出所有名称以`command`开头的命令；输入`*command`，可以搜索出所有名称以`command`结尾的命令；输入`*command*`，可以搜索出所有名称包含`command`的命令
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the command.

If you specify the `Provider` parameter parameter query public commands, fuzzy search is supported by default.

If you do not specify the `Provider` parameter parameter query private commands, fuzzy search is supported. For example, enter `test*` to search for all commands whose descriptions start with `test`, enter `*test` to search for all commands whose descriptions end with `test`, or enter `*test*` to search for all commands whose descriptions contain `test`
parameters.help_zh:
命令的描述。

当指定了`Provider`参数查询公共命令时，默认支持模糊查询。

当未指定`Provider`参数查询私有命令时，支持模糊查询，例如输入`test*`，可以搜索出所有描述以`test`开头的命令；例如输入`*test`，可以搜索出所有描述以`test`结尾的命令；例如输入`*test*`，可以搜索出所有描述包含`test`的命令
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the command. Valid values: 

RunBatScript: Bat script that runs on Windows instances.
RunPowerShellScript: PowerShell script that runs on Windows instances.
RunShellScript: shell script that runs on Linux instances
parameters.help_zh:
命令的类型。取值范围： 

RunBatScript：命令为在Windows实例中运行的Bat脚本。
RunPowerShellScript：命令为在Windows实例中运行的PowerShell脚本。
RunShellScript：命令为在Linux实例中运行的Shell脚本
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The encoding mode of the CommandContent and Output fields in the response. Valid values:
PlainText: returns the original script content and output.
Base64: returns Base64-encoded script content and output.

Default value: Base64
parameters.help_zh:
设置返回数据中`CommandContent`字段和`Output`字段的编码方式。取值范围：
PlainText：返回原始脚本内容和输出信息。
Base64：返回Base64编码后的脚本内容和输出信息。

默认值为Base64
parameters.name: content_encoding

parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: This parameter is about to be deprecated. Use NextToken and MaxResults to perform paging operations

The maximum number of entries per page for paging.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10

分页查询时每页的最大条目数。

最大值为50。

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the latest version of public commands when the query results include public commands. This parameter does not affect the query of private commands.

true: queries only the latest version of public commands.

false: queries all versions of public commands.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
若查询结果包含公共命令，是否只查询最新版本的公共命令。该参数不影响私有命令的查询。

true：只查询最新版本的公共命令。

false：查询所有版本的公共命令。

默认值：false
parameters.name: latest

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the command belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with this tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count with all specified tags attached cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html operation to query the resources.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
命令的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，您需要使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html接口进行查询。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
命令的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20。该值可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value
